checklist.title: Set up your grove
checklist.celebrateBody: Your όρια unlock the rest of Oleachron. Weather and satellite will appear on the field map.
checklist.continueBody: Draw the όρια to unlock Chronologio, photos and the rest of the app.

createGrove.title: Add your first grove
createGrove.body: Give it a name you will recognise — then pick a colour.

drawBoundary.title: Draw the boundary
drawBoundary.body: Search for the place, then mark the corners for area, slope and satellite.

loadData.title: Load grove data
loadData.body: We are fetching soil, slope and satellite for your boundary.

firstObservation.title: First observation
firstObservation.body: Leave a short note — it starts your Chronologio.

createGrove.title: Start with a name
createGrove.body: Type a short name, then tap Continue for the colour.

createColor.title: Pick a colour
createColor.body: One colour for the map and Chronologio — then Continue to boundary.

locatePlace.title: Find the place
locatePlace.body: Search for a village or area, or use your current location. Then we open the map to draw.

drawBoundary.title: Draw the boundary
drawBoundary.body: Tap the corners of the grove on the map. Save when the shape looks right.

firstObservation.title: Record your first note
firstObservation.body: A short observation starts Chronologio — you can post the suggested text as-is.

firstObservation.title: Start Chronologio with a note
firstObservation.body: Your grove details are ready. Post a first observation — we prepared a warm starter message you can send as-is or edit.
firstObservation.prefill: My first observation in the grove — Chronologio begins here.

spatial.title: Gathering your field data
spatial.body: Boundary saved. We are building a picture of this grove for you.
spatial.bodyNamed: “{{name}}” is on the map. We are building its weather, satellite and field picture.
spatial.firstDataHint: Weather usually arrives first; satellite and the grove profile follow. We open the welcome when the first pack is ready so the map already has something to show.
spatial.successBody: Continue to field details, then add your first observation.

weather.title: Weather for this grove
weather.body: Temperature, rain and wind around your trees.

satellite.title: Satellite view
satellite.body: Greenness and recent clear images over the boundary.

personalized.title: Your grove profile
personalized.body: Area, slope and soil notes tailored to this place.

welcome.title: Welcome to “{{grove}}”
welcome.body: Your first grove is ready. Next, open field details and leave a first observation — Chronologio grows from here.
welcome.pointWeather: Live weather sits under the map
welcome.pointSatellite: Satellite layers are ready when the sky is clear
welcome.pointMap: Your όρια define what Oleachron watches
